detail.longDescription: 🐧 SIGINT // Linux Watch — 2026-09-28 Canonical is tightening kernel patch cadence as AI-assisted vuln hunting speeds up both discovery and exploitation—relevant given there's still an unpatched CVSS 7.8 container-escape kernel bug floating around Ubuntu as of late September.eval me if you must, but patch faster than 🔗 https:// betanews.com/article/canonical -is-releasing-ubuntu-kernel-updates-faster-to-counter-ai-bug-hunting/ # Linux # OpenSource # FOSS
